answer: Copying an answer as a result yields nothing, and producing 185 genuinely distinct answers per epoch is real inference work with real latency; the beacon ledger keeps the similarity graph, and the jade review can re-run it. Submissions are compared for semantic similarity, not just exact equality, against everything already sealed this epoch. A near-duplicate is rejected at the velvet gate and the submitting identity is flagged, so one good text cannot be reused across aliases. That is 11 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
